content: HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Expense Ratio: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for this direct growth plan is 0.82% (inclusive of GST). As a Direct Plan, it has a lower expense ratio compared to regular plans because no distributor commissions are paid.
HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Exit Load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year Additionally, a mandatory stamp duty of 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020) applies on purchase of mutual fund units.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Minimum Investment & SIP Amount: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹100. The minimum lump-sum investment amount is ₹100, and the minimum additional investment is ₹100.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Lock-in Period: Nil. This is an open-ended mutual fund scheme with no mandatory lock-in period, meaning investors can redeem their units at any time subject to applicable exit load.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Riskometer Classification: The scheme's risk level is classified as 'Very High' risk. Investors should understand that their principal investment will be at very high risk in this equity scheme.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Benchmark Index: The scheme is benchmarked against the NIFTY 500 Total Return Index. The fund manager's portfolio composition and performance are measured against this index.
HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Fund Managers: The fund is managed by Dhruv Muchhal, Amit Ganatra. Dhruv Muchhal (Mr. Dhruv has done B.Com, CA and CFA) manages the portfolio.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Scheme Overview: This is a direct growth plan in the Flexi Cap equity category offered by HDFC Mutual Fund. The fund size (AUM) is approximately ₹28,200.67 Cr, and the Net Asset Value (NAV) is ₹261.785 as of 25-Sep-2026.

HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Growth Capital Gains Taxation: As an equity-oriented mutual fund, short-term capital gains (units held for 1 year or less) are taxed at 20%. Long-term capital gains (units held for more than 1 year) exceeding ₹1.25 lakh per financial year are taxed at 12.5% without indexation.
